coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variables (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, prefill timing, decoding timing, end-to-end timing, and peak memory usage. Timing metrics are accepted as semantic equivalents.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model architecture rather than holding LLaMA-2-7B fixed, and does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its methodology. Batch size and prefill length include 1 and 2048 but are expanded into sweeps rather than the specified single settings. Decode lengths are 128 and 512 instead of 32. Phase-specific computed speedup factors are not clearly specified as reporting metrics; qualitative speed expectations and latency differences are not equivalent.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the comparison of QuaRot 4-bit versus FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
